requirements.text: The FTSS shall perform system initialization including watchdog timer initiation, FCP virtual group synchronization, and configuration of ICP virtual groups within 1.5 minutes of power-on.
The scheduler shall execute cyclic tasks at 50 Hz, 10 Hz, and 1 Hz rates with a drift rate no greater than 50 microseconds per second and jitter no greater than 330 microseconds.
The scheduler shall support up to 5 vehicle modes, 3 rate groups per mode, and 20 tasks per rate group.
Communication services shall provide synchronous message queues and immediate pipe sockets for inter-task and inter-virtual group data exchange.
The system shall detect a babbling NE or ICP within 20 milliseconds and mask it out within 40 milliseconds.
Redundancy Management shall provide mechanisms to degrade the FCP virtual group, re-integrate processors, and recover from hardware failures within 1.5 minutes.
Time Services shall provide Mission Elapsed Time and Separation Elapsed Time with a drift rate of at most 50 PPM.
The system shall provide telemetry and command read services via MPCC devices, with automatic switching to redundant devices upon failure.
The FTSS software and VxWorks operating system shall utilize no more than 3 megabytes of ROM and 9 megabytes of DRAM.
Telemetry data transfer shall fit within an allocated budget of 5000 bits per second.
The FTSS shall be written in the C programming language and utilize VxWorks version 5.4.
The system shall be two-fault tolerant for any two non-simultaneous hardware faults throughout all mission phases.
The FTSS shall provide an API as defined in Draper document 297752 for application interaction with system services.
